detail.longDescription:
> I’m ( @mattyroses@lemmy.today [/u/mattyroses@lemmy.today]
[https://lemmy.today/u/mattyroses] )extremely happy to announce that
Neighborgoods 0.1 has been released! > > Neighborgoods is a platform which
allows people and organizations to setup a #library of many different kinds, and
federate them together to provide a large resource for borrowing, sharing, and
giving. > > This is our first release, which has basic setup of distributed
libraries , which are groups in an area where people share goods.
